title: Draft: Add ABI compliance checking using libabigail
description:
Restore ABI checking capability using modern libabigail tools.
Provides CMake targets (abi-dump, abi-check) and GitLab CI integration.

notes.body:
This is a new version for the change https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/commit/6e5ba74b31e5053c0ba0f3eaa79ff97d03eb5595 to add a new abi checker utility

Should also help avoiding issues like https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/issues/20881 in the future
Can this be moved to `tools/abi`? That's where we keep our various `check_*` scripts, and this arguably falls into the same category.

changed this line in [version 2 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/22542/diffs?diff_id=1586039382&start_sha=7533c5b4037e8235966b462ea5612ead28b9f35a#d98dc1b5e602c102ae8dcfa269f4724f735da5c4_32_6)

changed this file in [version 2 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/22542/diffs?diff_id=1586039382&start_sha=7533c5b4037e8235966b462ea5612ead28b9f35a#ba97601bfadbe942d4db7967add21eb4d6fb5c5b)

Is the idea to keep the abi dumps in the repository? I have no objection to doing that, but we also have the option of keeping them somewhere external, such as dev-libs. Also, should the dumps be versioned? We could potentially generate reports of changes between major versions if they were.

Yes, we will need to keep the versions for 4.6.0 around, as well as for other version. For now I have created a bash script, that will use docker to generate the dumps for any given version. I'll investigate how to move them somewhere external (actually like that better anyway) and then I submit the changes.
We need to keep at least the last release on each release branch around if we don't always regenerate it. IMO having it in the repo would be too much committed generated code.
I believe this is not the current policy, 4.6 -> 4.7 can break anything in the ABI. We just try to not break things unless there is good reason for it.

changed this line in [version 2 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/22542/diffs?diff_id=1586039382&start_sha=7533c5b4037e8235966b462ea5612ead28b9f35a#d98dc1b5e602c102ae8dcfa269f4724f735da5c4_25_6)

Having a baseline at .0 is not enough. We need to compare changes to the last .z release, because if we add a function in .1, remove it in .2 then this is an API breakage from .1, but not from the baseline. We can add functions in .z releases.

Agreed. That was from an initial design. 

Do you foresee an issue if we create the abi files purely on Debian for the other distros? Currently I am using bookworm for the creation, but thinking of stepping down to bullseye. Trixie seems a bit too new for my taste to base this on that.

In theory the ABI could be used cross-distro because the exported symbols and structs use base types/structs that are typically similar, but I'd rather standardize on a particular distro for the lifetime of a release branch at least to avoid surprises.
Differences can come from reexporting structs/types coming from external libraries, which I believe is rare in Wireshark's API, if there is even an example of that.

Also I'd use latest stable, i.e. Trixie, because we (or others internally) may keep 4.6.x updated for quite some time and Trixie's EOL is ~2 years later.

@@ -0,0 +1,6 @@

@@ -0,0 +1,228 @@
+# ABICheck.cmake
+#
+# Add targets for ABI compliance checking using libabigail
+#
+# Provides two targets:
+#   abi-dump:  Generate ABI dumps for all libraries (for creating baselines)
+#   abi-check: Check current libraries against baseline ABI dumps
+#
+# Usage:
+#   cmake -DENABLE_ABI_CHECK=ON ..
+#   ninja abi-dump    # Generate new baseline
+#   ninja abi-check   # Check against baseline
+#
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-or-later
+
+option(ENABLE_ABI_CHECK "Enable ABI compliance checking targets" OFF)
+
+if(ENABLE_ABI_CHECK)
+	find_program(ABIDW_EXECUTABLE abidw
+		DOC "Path to abidw from libabigail"
+	)
+	find_program(ABIDIFF_EXECUTABLE abidiff
+		DOC "Path to abidiff from libabigail"
+	)
+
+	if(NOT ABIDW_EXECUTABLE)
+		message(WARNING "abidw not found - ABI checking disabled. Install libabigail.")
+		set(ENABLE_ABI_CHECK OFF)
+	elseif(NOT ABIDIFF_EXECUTABLE)
+		message(WARNING "abidiff not found - ABI checking disabled. Install libabigail.")
+		set(ENABLE_ABI_CHECK OFF)
+	else()
+		message(STATUS "ABI checking enabled using libabigail")
+		message(STATUS "  abidw: ${ABIDW_EXECUTABLE}")
+		message(STATUS "  abidiff: ${ABIDIFF_EXECUTABLE}")
+	endif()
+endif()
+
+# ABI check is only supported on amd64/arm64 architectures
+if(NOT MANIFEST_PROCESSOR_ARCHITECTURE STREQUAL "amd64" AND NOT MANIFEST_PROCESSOR_ARCHITECTURE STREQUAL "arm64")
+	message(WARNING "ABI checking is only supported on amd64 and arm64 architectures.")
+	set(ENABLE_ABI_CHECK OFF)
+endif()
+
+set(ABI_BASEVERSION "v${PROJECT_VERSION}_${MANIFEST_PROCESSOR_ARCHITECTURE}")
+set(ABI_BASELINE_BASE_URL "https://dev-libs.wireshark.org/abi")
+
+if(ENABLE_ABI_CHECK)
+	set(ABI_BASELINE_READY FALSE)
+	set(ABI_BASELINE_URL "${ABI_BASELINE_BASE_URL}/${ABI_BASEVERSION}")
+	set(ABI_LOCAL_BASELINE_DIR "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/abi/${ABI_BASEVERSION}")
+	set(ABI_DOWNLOADED_BASELINE_DIR "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/abi/baseline/${ABI_BASEVERSION}")
+	set(ABI_BASELINE_FILES
+		libwsutil.abi
+		libwiretap.abi
+		libwireshark.abi
+	)
+
+if(EXISTS "${ABI_LOCAL_BASELINE_DIR}")
+	set(ABI_MISSING_BASELINE_FILES)
+	foreach(baseline_file IN LISTS ABI_BASELINE_FILES)
+		if(NOT EXISTS "${ABI_LOCAL_BASELINE_DIR}/${baseline_file}")
+			list(APPEND ABI_MISSING_BASELINE_FILES "${baseline_file}")
+		endif()
+	endforeach()
+	if(ABI_MISSING_BASELINE_FILES)
+		message(WARNING "Local ABI baseline directory ${ABI_LOCAL_BASELINE_DIR} is missing file(s): ${ABI_MISSING_BASELINE_FILES}")
+	else()
+		set(ABI_BASELINE_DIR "${ABI_LOCAL_BASELINE_DIR}")
+		set(ABI_BASELINE_READY TRUE)
+		message(STATUS "Using local ABI baseline: ${ABI_BASELINE_DIR}")
+	endif()
+endif()
+
+if(NOT ABI_BASELINE_READY)
+	set(ABI_BASELINE_DIR "${ABI_DOWNLOADED_BASELINE_DIR}")
+	set(ABI_BASELINE_READY TRUE)
+	file(MAKE_DIRECTORY "${ABI_BASELINE_DIR}")
+	foreach(baseline_file IN LISTS ABI_BASELINE_FILES)
+		set(local_baseline_file "${ABI_BASELINE_DIR}/${baseline_file}")
+		if(NOT EXISTS "${local_baseline_file}")
+			set(remote_url "${ABI_BASELINE_URL}/${baseline_file}")
+			message(STATUS "Downloading ABI baseline ${baseline_file} from ${remote_url}")
+			file(DOWNLOAD
+				"${remote_url}"
+				"${local_baseline_file}"
+				STATUS download_status
+			)
+			list(POP_FRONT download_status download_result)
+			if(NOT download_result EQUAL 0)
+				list(LENGTH download_status download_status_len)
+				if(download_status_len GREATER 0)
+					list(GET download_status 0 download_message)
+				else()
+					set(download_message "Unknown error")
+				endif()
+				set(ABI_BASELINE_READY FALSE)
+				message(WARNING "Unable to download ${remote_url}: ${download_message}")
+				file(REMOVE "${local_baseline_file}")
+				break()
+			endif()
+		endif()
+	endforeach()
+endif()
+
+	# Output directory for generated dumps
+	set(ABI_OUTPUT_DIR "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/abi")
+
+	# Common abidw flags to ensure portable ABI dumps
+	set(ABIDW_FLAGS
+		--no-corpus-path
+		--no-comp-dir-path
+		--exported-interfaces-only
+	)
+
+	# Create output directory
+	file(MAKE_DIRECTORY ${ABI_OUTPUT_DIR})
+
+	#
+	# abi-dump target: Generate ABI dumps for all libraries
+	#
+	# Individual library dump targets
+	add_custom_target(abi-dump-wsutil
+		COMMAND ${ABIDW_EXECUTABLE} ${ABIDW_FLAGS}
+			$<TARGET_FILE:wsutil> > ${ABI_OUTPUT_DIR}/libwsutil.abi
+		DEPENDS wsutil
+		COMMENT "Generating ABI dump for libwsutil"
+		VERBATIM
+	)
+
+	add_custom_target(abi-dump-wiretap
+		COMMAND ${ABIDW_EXECUTABLE} ${ABIDW_FLAGS}
+			$<TARGET_FILE:wiretap> > ${ABI_OUTPUT_DIR}/libwiretap.abi
+		DEPENDS wiretap
+		COMMENT "Generating ABI dump for libwiretap"
+		VERBATIM
+	)
+
+	add_custom_target(abi-dump-epan
+		COMMAND ${ABIDW_EXECUTABLE} ${ABIDW_FLAGS}
+			$<TARGET_FILE:epan> > ${ABI_OUTPUT_DIR}/libwireshark.abi
+		DEPENDS epan
+		COMMENT "Generating ABI dump for libwireshark (epan)"
+		VERBATIM
+	)
+
+	# Combined dump target
+	add_custom_target(abi-dump
+		DEPENDS abi-dump-wsutil abi-dump-wiretap abi-dump-epan
+		COMMENT "ABI dumps generated in ${ABI_OUTPUT_DIR}/"
+	)
+
+	set_target_properties(abi-dump abi-dump-wsutil abi-dump-wiretap abi-dump-epan
+		PROPERTIES
+			FOLDER "Auxiliary/ABI"
+			EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL True
+			EXCLUDE_FROM_DEFAULT_BUILD True
+	)
+
+	#
+	# abi-check target: Check libraries against baseline
+	#
+	if(ABI_BASELINE_READY)
+		message(STATUS "ABI baseline found: ${ABI_BASELINE_DIR}")
+
+		# Individual library check targets
+		add_custom_target(abi-check-wsutil
+			COMMAND ${ABIDIFF_EXECUTABLE}
+				${ABI_BASELINE_DIR}/libwsutil.abi
+				$<TARGET_FILE:wsutil>
+			DEPENDS wsutil
+			COMMENT "Checking ABI compatibility for libwsutil"
+			VERBATIM
+		)
+
+		add_custom_target(abi-check-wiretap
+			COMMAND ${ABIDIFF_EXECUTABLE}
+				${ABI_BASELINE_DIR}/libwiretap.abi
+				$<TARGET_FILE:wiretap>
+			DEPENDS wiretap
+			COMMENT "Checking ABI compatibility for libwiretap"
+			VERBATIM
+		)
+
+		add_custom_target(abi-check-epan
+			COMMAND ${ABIDIFF_EXECUTABLE}
+				${ABI_BASELINE_DIR}/libwireshark.abi
+				$<TARGET_FILE:epan>
+			DEPENDS epan
+			COMMENT "Checking ABI compatibility for libwireshark (epan)"
+			VERBATIM
+		)
+
+		# Combined check target
+		add_custom_target(abi-check
+			DEPENDS abi-check-wsutil abi-check-wiretap abi-check-epan
+			COMMENT "ABI compatibility check complete"
+		)
+
+		set_target_properties(abi-check abi-check-wsutil abi-check-wiretap abi-check-epan
+			PROPERTIES
+				FOLDER "Auxiliary/ABI"
+				EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL True
+				EXCLUDE_FROM_DEFAULT_BUILD True
+		)
+	else()
+		message(STATUS "No ABI baseline for ${ABI_BASEVERSION}")
+		message(STATUS "  Attempted download from ${ABI_BASELINE_URL}")
+		message(STATUS "  Run 'ninja abi-dump' to generate baseline and publish it to ${ABI_BASELINE_URL}")
+
+		# Create a placeholder target that explains the situation
+		add_custom_target(abi-check
+			COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E echo "No ABI baseline found for version ${ABI_BASEVERSION}"
+			COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E echo "Attempted download from ${ABI_BASELINE_URL}"
+			COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E echo "Generate baseline with: tools/abi/create_abi_dump.sh v${PROJECT_VERSION} ${MANIFEST_PROCESSOR_ARCHITECTURE}"
+			COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E echo "Then upload ${ABI_OUTPUT_DIR}/*.abi to ${ABI_BASELINE_URL}"
+			COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E false
+			COMMENT "ABI check failed - no baseline"
+		)
+
+		set_target_properties(abi-check
+			PROPERTIES
+				FOLDER "Auxiliary/ABI"
+				EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL True
+				EXCLUDE_FROM_DEFAULT_BUILD True
+		)
+	endif()
+endif()

@@ -0,0 +1,122 @@
+# ABI Baseline Files
+
+ABI Baseline Files allow us to monitor changes to the ABI of our three libraries that
+are usually used for external linking (wiretap, wsutil and wireshark). This is done in
+order to guarantee that during Major.Minor release cycles breaks in the ABI compatibility
+do not occur.
+
+SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-or-later
+
+## Overview
+
+Wireshark uses [libabigail](https://sourceware.org/libabigail/) to check ABI
+compatibility between releases. This helps ensure that plugins and applications
+built against older library versions continue to work with newer releases.
+
+libabigail is so far only available for ELF binaries that are accompanied by the DWARF
+file format for debug information. Therefore we can only do this reliably on Linux for
+now. This will leave holes for Windows/macOS, but the vast majority of issues will still
+be caught.
+
+## Libraries Tracked
+
+- **libwsutil** - Utility functions library
+- **libwiretap** - Capture file I/O library
+- **libwireshark** (epan) - Packet dissection engine
+
+## ABI Compatibility Policy
+
+| Release Type | ABI Must Be Compatible | Notes |
+|--------------|------------------------|-------|
+| Major (4.x -> 5.x) | No | Can break freely |
+| Minor (4.6 -> 4.7) | Yes | Must maintain backward compatibility |
+| Patch (4.7.0 -> 4.7.1) | Yes | Must maintain; can restore if previous patch broke |
+| Security fix | Override | May break ABI with maintainer approval |
+
+For every new major.minor version (4.6.x, 4.7.x, ...) a set of dump files must be added
+to the dev-libs repository. The script create_abi_dump.sh uses docker to create those
+dumbs on any system allowing for cross-architecture docker runs (macOS, Linux).
+
+## Directory Structure
+
+```
+tools/abi/
+├── README.md            # This file
+├── check_abi_report.py  # Helper utility for performing a check
+├── create_abi_dump.sh   # Helper utility for creating the baseline dumps
+```
+
+## Creating Baselines
+
+At each x.y.0 release, generate new baselines:
+
+```bash
+# Go to a fresh checkout of Wireshark Src code
+cd wireshark
+
+# Run the dump utility for each version/architecture
+tools/abi/create_abi_dump.sh vX.Y.0 arm64
+tools/abi/create_abi_dump.sh vX.Y.0 amd64
+
+# Commit the baseline
+git add ../abi/vX.Y.0_arm64/ ../abi/vX.Y.0_amd64/
+git commit -m "Add ABI baseline for X.Y"
+```
+
+## Local ABI Checking
+
+Developers can check ABI compatibility locally:
+
+```bash
+mkdir build && cd build
+cmake -GNinja -DENABLE_ABI_CHECK=ON ..
+ninja wsutil wiretap epan
+ninja abi-check
+```
+
+## CI/CD Integration
+
+The GitLab CI pipeline automatically runs ABI checks on merge requests:
+
+1. Builds the libraries from the merge request
+2. Compares against the baseline for the current major.minor version
+3. Reports any ABI changes (additions, removals, modifications)
+4. Fails the check if breaking changes are detected
+
+The job is configured with `allow_failure: true`, enabling maintainers to
+merge security fixes that intentionally break ABI.
+
+## Requirements
+
+- **libabigail** package installed (provides `abidiff`, `abidw`)
+  - Ubuntu/Debian: `apt install abigail-tools`
+  - Fedora: `dnf install libabigail`
+  - macOS: `brew install libabigail`
+
+- Libraries must be built with debug information:
+  - `CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug` or `RelWithDebInfo` (default)
+
+## Understanding ABI Reports
+
+The `abidiff` tool reports several types of changes:
+
+- **Removed functions/variables** - Breaking change, will cause link errors
+- **Changed functions** - Breaking change if signature differs
+- **Added functions/variables** - Compatible, new functionality
+
+Example output:
+```
+Functions changes summary: 0 Removed, 2 Changed, 5 Added functions
+Variables changes summary: 0 Removed, 0 Changed, 1 Added variable
+```
+
+## Suppressing False Positives
+
+If `abidiff` reports changes that are known to be safe, you can create
+suppression files. Contact the development team for guidance.
+
+## References
+
+- [Libabigail Documentation](https://sourceware.org/libabigail/manual/)
+- [abidiff Manual](https://sourceware.org/libabigail/manual/abidiff.html)
+- [abidw Manual](https://sourceware.org/libabigail/manual/abidw.html)

@@ -0,0 +1,209 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""
+Parse abidiff output files and generate a summary report.
+
+This script reads abidiff output from individual library reports and
+generates a consolidated summary indicating ABI compatibility status.
+
+Exit codes:
+    0 - No ABI changes or only additions (compatible)
+    1 - Breaking ABI changes detected (removed/changed symbols)
+
+Usage:
+    python3 abi-check-report.py <report_directory>
+
+SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-or-later
+"""
+
+import sys
+import re
+from pathlib import Path
+
+
+def parse_abidiff_output(filepath):
+    """
+    Parse abidiff output file and categorize changes.
+
+    Returns a dict with:
+        - removed: list of removed functions/variables
+        - changed: list of changed functions/variables
+        - added: list of added functions/variables
+        - error: error message if abidiff failed
+    """
+    changes = {
+        'removed': [],
+        'changed': [],
+        'added': [],
+        'error': None
+    }
+
+    if not filepath.exists():
+        changes['error'] = f"Report file not found: {filepath}"
+        return changes
+
+    content = filepath.read_text()
+
+    # Check for abidiff errors
+    if 'error:' in content.lower():
+        changes['error'] = content.strip()
+        return changes
+
+    # Parse removed functions
+    removed_pattern = re.compile(
+        r"(\d+) Removed function[s]?.*?:(.*?)(?=\d+ (?:Removed|Changed|Added)|$)",
+        re.DOTALL
+    )
+    for match in removed_pattern.finditer(content):
+        items = match.group(2).strip()
+        if items:
+            changes['removed'].extend(
+                line.strip() for line in items.split('\n')
+                if line.strip() and not line.strip().startswith('[')
+            )
+
+    # Parse removed variables
+    removed_var_pattern = re.compile(
+        r"(\d+) Removed variable[s]?.*?:(.*?)(?=\d+ (?:Removed|Changed|Added)|$)",
+        re.DOTALL
+    )
+    for match in removed_var_pattern.finditer(content):
+        items = match.group(2).strip()
+        if items:
+            changes['removed'].extend(
+                line.strip() for line in items.split('\n')
+                if line.strip() and not line.strip().startswith('[')
+            )
+
+    # Parse changed functions
+    changed_pattern = re.compile(
+        r"(\d+) Changed function[s]?.*?:(.*?)(?=\d+ (?:Removed|Changed|Added)|$)",
+        re.DOTALL
+    )
+    for match in changed_pattern.finditer(content):
+        items = match.group(2).strip()
+        if items:
+            changes['changed'].extend(
+                line.strip() for line in items.split('\n')
+                if line.strip() and not line.strip().startswith('[')
+            )
+
+    # Parse changed variables
+    changed_var_pattern = re.compile(
+        r"(\d+) Changed variable[s]?.*?:(.*?)(?=\d+ (?:Removed|Changed|Added)|$)",
+        re.DOTALL
+    )
+    for match in changed_var_pattern.finditer(content):
+        items = match.group(2).strip()
+        if items:
+            changes['changed'].extend(
+                line.strip() for line in items.split('\n')
+                if line.strip() and not line.strip().startswith('[')
+            )
+
+    # Parse added functions
+    added_pattern = re.compile(
+        r"(\d+) Added function[s]?.*?:(.*?)(?=\d+ (?:Removed|Changed|Added)|$)",
+        re.DOTALL
+    )
+    for match in added_pattern.finditer(content):
+        items = match.group(2).strip()
+        if items:
+            changes['added'].extend(
+                line.strip() for line in items.split('\n')
+                if line.strip() and not line.strip().startswith('[')
+            )
+
+    # Parse added variables
+    added_var_pattern = re.compile(
+        r"(\d+) Added variable[s]?.*?:(.*?)(?=\d+ (?:Removed|Changed|Added)|$)",
+        re.DOTALL
+    )
+    for match in added_var_pattern.finditer(content):
+        items = match.group(2).strip()
+        if items:
+            changes['added'].extend(
+                line.strip() for line in items.split('\n')
+                if line.strip() and not line.strip().startswith('[')
+            )
+
+    return changes
+
+
+def main():
+    if len(sys.argv) != 2:
+        print(f"Usage: {sys.argv[0]} <report_directory>", file=sys.stderr)
+        return 2
+
+    report_dir = Path(sys.argv[1])
+    if not report_dir.is_dir():
+        print(f"Error: {report_dir} is not a directory", file=sys.stderr)
+        return 2
+
+    libraries = ['wsutil', 'wiretap', 'wireshark']
+    has_breaking = False
+    has_changes = False
+
+    print("=" * 60)
+    print("ABI Compatibility Report")
+    print("=" * 60)
+    print()
+
+    for lib in libraries:
+        report_file = report_dir / f"{lib}.txt"
+        changes = parse_abidiff_output(report_file)
+
+        lib_display = f"lib{lib}"
+
+        if changes['error']:
+            print(f"ERROR: {lib_display}")
+            print(f"  {changes['error']}")
+            print()
+            continue
+
+        removed_count = len(changes['removed'])
+        changed_count = len(changes['changed'])
+        added_count = len(changes['added'])
+
+        if removed_count > 0 or changed_count > 0:
+            print(f"BREAKING: {lib_display}")
+            has_breaking = True
+            has_changes = True
+
+            if removed_count > 0:
+                print(f"  Removed symbols: {removed_count}")
+                for item in changes['removed'][:5]:  # Show first 5
+                    print(f"    - {item}")
+                if removed_count > 5:
+                    print(f"    ... and {removed_count - 5} more")
+
+            if changed_count > 0:
+                print(f"  Changed symbols: {changed_count}")
+                for item in changes['changed'][:5]:  # Show first 5
+                    print(f"    - {item}")
+                if changed_count > 5:
+                    print(f"    ... and {changed_count - 5} more")
+
+        elif added_count > 0:
+            print(f"INFO: {lib_display} - {added_count} new symbols (compatible)")
+            has_changes = True
+
+        else:
+            print(f"OK: {lib_display} - no ABI changes")
+
+        print()
+
+    print("=" * 60)
+    if has_breaking:
+        print("RESULT: ABI breaking changes detected!")
+        print("        Merge requires maintainer approval.")
+        return 1
+    elif has_changes:
+        print("RESULT: ABI compatible (additions only)")
+        return 0
+    else:
+        print("RESULT: No ABI changes")
+        return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    sys.exit(main())

+#!/bin/bash
+
+# This script creates ABI dumps for Wireshark shared libraries using abidw inside a Docker container.
+# Usage: ./tools/create_abi_dump.sh [version] [platform]
+# Example: ./tools/create_abi_dump.sh v4.6.0 amd64
+#
+# See abi/Readme.md for more details.
+
+# Check docker executable availability
+docker_bin=$(command -v docker 2>/dev/null)
+if [ -z "$docker_bin" ]; then
+    echo "Error: Docker is not installed or not in PATH."
+    exit 1
+fi
+# Check docker usability
+if ! docker info >/dev/null 2>&1; then
+    echo "Error: Docker is installed but not usable by current user."
+    exit 2
+fi
+
+# Verify we are in a Wireshark source tree
+if [ ! -f "CMakeLists.txt" ] || [ ! -f "tools/make-version.py" ] || [ ! -f "cmake/modules/ABICheck.cmake" ]; then
+    echo "Error: This does not look like a Wireshark source tree, or you are not in root of the source directory."
+    exit 3
+fi
+
+# Check for required arguments
+if [ -z "$1" ] || [ -z "$2" ]; then
+    echo "Error: Two arguments required"
+    echo "Usage: ./tools/create_abi_dump.sh [version] [platform]"
+    exit 4
+fi
+
+VERSION=${1:-undefined}
+PLATFORM=${2:-amd64}
+BUILD_DIR=./build-linux
+SOURCE_DIR=$(pwd)
+CONTAINER_SRC=/src
+DEBIAN_RELEASE=bookworm # Debian 12
+
+# --- Git / tag handling outside Docker -------------------------------------
+
+# Ensure git is available
+git_bin=$(command -v git 2>/dev/null)
+if [ -z "$git_bin" ]; then
+    echo "Error: git is not installed or not in PATH."
+    exit 5
+fi
+
+# Ensure the tag exists
+tag_exists=$(git tag -l "$VERSION")
+if [ -z "$tag_exists" ]; then
+    echo "Error: Tag '$VERSION' does not exist in this repository."
+    exit 6
+fi
+
+# Remember current ref to restore later
+ORIG_REF=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null)
+if [ -z "$ORIG_REF" ]; then
+    ORIG_REF="HEAD"
+fi
+
+TMP_BRANCH="abidump_${VERSION}"
+
+# Create / move to temporary branch at the tag
+git checkout -B "$TMP_BRANCH" "$VERSION" >/dev/null 2>&1
+if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then
+    echo "Error: Could not check out tag '$VERSION' into branch '$TMP_BRANCH'."
+    exit 7
+fi
+
+# Ensure we restore the original branch and clean up tmp branch on exit
+cleanup_git_state() {
+    git checkout "$ORIG_REF" >/dev/null 2>&1
+    git branch -D "$TMP_BRANCH" >/dev/null 2>&1
+}
+trap cleanup_git_state EXIT
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+# Create output directory on HOST if it doesn't exist
+if [ ! -d ${SOURCE_DIR}/abi/${VERSION}_${PLATFORM} ] ; then
+    mkdir -p ${SOURCE_DIR}/abi/${VERSION}_${PLATFORM}
+fi
+
+# Clean up old build dir only if it exists
+if [ -d ${SOURCE_DIR}/${BUILD_DIR} ] ; then
+    rm -rf ${SOURCE_DIR}/${BUILD_DIR}
+fi
+mkdir -p ${SOURCE_DIR}/${BUILD_DIR}
+
+ABIDW_FLAGS="--no-corpus-path --no-comp-dir-path --exported-interfaces-only"
+
+docker run --platform linux/${PLATFORM} --rm -v ${SOURCE_DIR}:${CONTAINER_SRC} debian:${DEBIAN_RELEASE} bash -c "
+    set -e
+    DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive ${CONTAINER_SRC}/tools/debian-setup.sh --install-optional --install-qt6-deps -y &&
+    apt-get install -y abigail-tools &&
+    cd ${CONTAINER_SRC}/${BUILD_DIR} &&
+    cmake -DBUILD_wireshark=off -G Ninja .. &&
+    cmake --build . &&
+    abidw ${ABIDW_FLAGS} ${CONTAINER_SRC}/${BUILD_DIR}/run/libwireshark.so --out-file ${CONTAINER_SRC}/abi/${VERSION}_${PLATFORM}/libwireshark.abi &&
+    abidw ${ABIDW_FLAGS} ${CONTAINER_SRC}/${BUILD_DIR}/run/libwiretap.so --out-file ${CONTAINER_SRC}/abi/${VERSION}_${PLATFORM}/libwiretap.abi &&
+    abidw ${ABIDW_FLAGS} ${CONTAINER_SRC}/${BUILD_DIR}/run/libwsutil.so --out-file ${CONTAINER_SRC}/abi/${VERSION}_${PLATFORM}/libwsutil.abi
+"
\ No newline at end of file

+ABI Check:
+  extends: .build-ubuntu
+  stage: analysis
+  rules: !reference [.if-plain-merge-request]
+  script:
+    # Install libabigail (TODO: add to wireshark-containers/ubuntu-dev instead)
+    - apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq abigail-tools > /dev/null
+    # build-ubuntu puts us in `build`.
+    - cd ..
+    # Determine baseline version
+    - MAJOR=$(grep -oP 'set\(PROJECT_MAJOR_VERSION\s+\K\d+' CMakeLists.txt)
+    - MINOR=$(grep -oP 'set\(PROJECT_MINOR_VERSION\s+\K\d+' CMakeLists.txt)
+    - BASELINE_DIR="abi/${MAJOR}.${MINOR}"
+    - echo "Checking ABI against baseline ${MAJOR}.${MINOR}"
+    # Check if baseline exists
+    - |
+      if [ -d "$BASELINE_DIR" ]; then
+        cd build
+        # Build only the libraries we need
+        ninja wsutil wiretap epan
+        cd ..
+        mkdir -p abi_reports
+        # Check each library and capture output
+        echo "Checking libwsutil..."
+        abidiff ${BASELINE_DIR}/libwsutil.abi build/run/libwsutil.so > abi_reports/wsutil.txt 2>&1 || true
+        echo "Checking libwiretap..."
+        abidiff ${BASELINE_DIR}/libwiretap.abi build/run/libwiretap.so > abi_reports/wiretap.txt 2>&1 || true
+        echo "Checking libwireshark..."
+        abidiff ${BASELINE_DIR}/libwireshark.abi build/run/libwireshark.so > abi_reports/wireshark.txt 2>&1 || true
+        # Generate summary report
+        python3 tools/abi-check-report.py abi_reports/ | tee abi_summary.txt
+        # Check for breaking changes
+        if grep -q "BREAKING" abi_summary.txt; then
+          echo ""
+          echo "ABI breaking changes detected. Maintainer approval required to merge."
+          exit 1
+        fi
+      else
+        echo "No ABI baseline found for version ${MAJOR}.${MINOR}"
+        echo "Skipping ABI check - baseline will be created at release time."
+      fi
+  artifacts:
+    when: always
+    paths:
+      - abi_reports/
+      - abi_summary.txt
+    expire_in: 1 week
+  allow_failure: true
+
